title: Automated Design Space Exploration in High-Level Physical Synthesis
extraction_scope: PDF first-page identity; IV framework; VII-C/D overall timing and execution time; Table V page 8 selected columns visually verified.
mechanism: Physical implementation feedback guides device abstraction, constrained ILP floorplanning and pipeline/routing choices.

conditions.scope: Six accelerator designs across four multi-die FPGA architectures, not necessarily a complete Cartesian product.
baselines: AMD Vitis, -O3 Explore, target reduced from 300 MHz in 15 MHz steps until PnR succeeds
conditions.parallelism: Up to four concurrent Vitis jobs per batch; search dependencies limit actual parallelism.

limits: Fmax is not application throughput or faster synthesis.
Table V actions are cumulative, not independent ablations.
No matched-budget superiority established here; unequal-population headline means and failed implementation are preserved in PDF verification.
Technical coding is integrated, but neither it nor the prepared packet establishes independent acceptance.

semantics: Six distinct designs give seven design/device cases because MM 10x13 is tested on two boards.
N/A means no successful Vitis implementation found for that table entry, not zero frequency.
Crossed-out frequencies denote a step worse than an earlier result; do not replace retained best with the final step.
Elapsed hours are cumulative through each action; hours_through_best_action is not an exact timestamp of the first best candidate.
Parallel job batches prevent interpreting elapsed hours as summed CPU-hours.

aggregation.interpretation: The reported 1.67 is arithmetically consistent with unequal-population means. The shared-case ratio 1.65 excludes a baseline failure and is not a complete superiority verdict; report that failure separately.

limits: No equal search-budget comparison or application-throughput gain established.
Arithmetic and visual checks are researcher verification, not experimental reproduction or independent acceptance.

next_action: Coding/source packet prepared with Fmax, unequal-population means, baseline failure and cumulative search runtime kept separate; seek matched-budget evidence and independent review.
